summary: Firefighters were sent to an outside fire in the alley behind the 600 block of Richards Avenue, where a transient was setting debris on fire.
Officers were sent to the 10400 block of Main Street for a welfare check on a young woman reported to be in crisis.
Officers were sent to a business in the 6100 block of Niles Street for a theft in progress, a woman reported to be leaving with items she had not paid for.

area: Miller Street and East California Avenue
summary: A caller reported a fire at Miller Street and East California Avenue and told dispatchers the flames were out, saying they believed someone had told the person to put it out.
Officers were sent to the 1500 block of Locust Ravine for a verbal disturbance involving an elderly woman said to have a weapon, though none was seen.
Officers were sent to Chester Avenue for a report of a person who appeared to be under the influence.
Officers were sent to Hughes Lane and White Lane for a welfare check on a 7-year-old reported to be in the company of a transient adult.
Officers were sent to the 200 block of Fairfax Road for a domestic violence call that came in second-hand.

disposition: one person down; complex and neighborhood searched, no other arrests
summary: Officers working at Monitor Street and Pacheco Road reported that a subject had fired about five shots at them, and the man was down with a gun still in his hand. A second person in a black hoodie ran northbound through the apartment complex just west of the scene, and police said three other people may have gone into the neighborhood to the north. A drone and a Bearcat were brought in, officers cleared a parking area by hand and searched the buildings and carports, then reported the complex and the neighborhood to the west clear.
Officers were sent to the 200 block of Dogwood Lane for a welfare check on a man who wanted to be picked up.

Officers were sent to a standoff call in the 1200 block of Quincy Street with arguing heard in the background. The man in the residence had a warrant, and officers said he fled on foot and was under the influence of methamphetamine.

Officers were sent to the 800 block of Roberts Lane after a crisis line relayed a report of a person in crisis with access to a firearm inside an apartment. The information was second-hand and the person was not armed at the time of the call.

agency: Bakersfield Police Department / Bakersfield Fire Department
area: Truxtun Avenue east of Westside Parkway
summary: A vehicle crash was reported on Truxtun Avenue east of Westside Parkway, and police advised that a pedestrian had also been struck at the location. Medics tagged four patients and a couple of people were taken to the hospital by ambulance.
Officers were sent to the 100 block of Elton Avenue after a report of a 7-year-old outside a residence calling for her mother.
Officers were sent to the 1200 block of Quincy Street after a neighbor reported a woman yelling and the sound of a disturbance inside an apartment.

area: Lerdo Justice Facility on Industrial Farm Road
summary: County crews were sent to the Lerdo Justice Facility on Industrial Farm Road for a fire in the jail infirmary.

Officers took a carjacking report and recovered the vehicle, which was left at the scene. The suspect fled in a white older-model Honda Accord southbound on 8th Street from Maurice Avenue and was reported to possibly have a handgun.
Firefighters were sent to a fire on Stockdale Highway reported to be larger than a vehicle.
A small grass fire was reported off Calloway Drive, and one engine handled it.

disposition: knocked down; three uninvolved units kept habitable
summary: Multiple callers reported a small apartment complex on fire in the 400 block of Niles Street, with reports of people trying to save children and children screaming inside. Crews found heavy smoke venting from a second-story window of a middle unit, pulled attack lines and checked the adjacent structure to the delta side. A reconnaissance group evacuated the units next to the fire, and PG&E was asked to isolate power to the single unit. The three units not involved were found habitable, which kept those families from being displaced.
Officers were sent to a business in the 4000 block of Ming Avenue for a suspicious person report.
Officers were sent to a business in the 1900 block of Chester Avenue after a report of a man trying to break a window with a large rock.

Officers were sent to the 200 block of Bighorn Meadow Drive after a man reported that a rideshare driver had locked his girlfriend inside the vehicle and driven off. Officers later reached the woman by phone.

agency: Kern County Fire Department / Bakersfield Fire Department
disposition: reinforced; fire reached the storage business
summary: Crews went to a large stack of pallets burning in a yard off Kernita Road, with adjacent buildings and high-tension power lines in the path of the fire. Battalion 4 took command and made the power lines the priority, water was stretched from a hydrant to the west, and the response was reinforced when the fire reached the Public Storage on the property. Police were asked to shut the street down in both directions while hose lines were laid through the aisles of the storage yard.
Officers were sent to the 600 block of Water Street for an open line between a man and a woman with what a dispatcher described as a possible struggle.

Officers were sent to the 7000 block of Eucalyptus Drive for a report of a 65-year-old man alone in an apartment and in possession of a knife. The caller had separated himself from the man before officers arrived.
Officers were sent to the 12800 block of South Union Avenue for a man standing in the middle of the roadway.
Officers were sent to a business in the 6100 block of Niles Street for a man with a screwdriver reported to be walking through the parking lot and looking into vehicles.

area: Panama Lane and Buena Vista Road
summary: Police broadcast a stolen vehicle last seen heading east from Panama Lane and Buena Vista Road.
Officers were sent to the 1900 block of East California Avenue for a 911 hang-up.
Patient found unresponsive at Mount Vernon Avenue.
Person in cardiac arrest at El Camino Avenue.
Driver reportedly brandished handgun on I-5.
Police investigate man claiming warrant and weapon.
Man overdosing on fentanyl, not breathing.
Unconscious person found at Sue's Tavern in Frazier Park.
Two-vehicle crash at Road and Enos Lane.
